title: .yasrt.yaml
description: Configuration for yasrt. Layered: files given via --defaults or YASRT_DEFAULTS merge under this one, so a repository only states what differs from its component's defaults. `product` is required in the merged result, not necessarily in this file.

product.description: What this repository ships. Derives non_release_paths and tag_format.

tag_format.description: Tag template. Defaults to ${version} for image and custom, v${version} for package and extension.

initial.description: Version of the first release, when no tag exists.

major_on_zero.description: When false, a breaking change below 1.0.0 bumps the minor version instead.

prereleases.description: Maps a branch to the prerelease identifier its releases carry, e.g. {develop: rc}. Branches not listed cut stable releases.

maintenance.description: Branches that release inside a fixed version range, written as semantic-release writes them: 1.x keeps a release inside major 1, 1.2.x inside minor 1.2. A bump that would leave the range is lowered rather than refused.

rules.description: First matching rule wins per commit; the highest bump across commits wins overall.

scopes.description: Commit scopes that never release. `release` is always present and cannot be removed.

authors.description: Matches the author name, the full address, or the local part of the address.

trailers.description: Markers such as [skip release] in the body, or a matching footer token.

non_release_paths.description: Replaces the list derived from product entirely. Required when product is custom.

sections.description: Rendered in this order; empty sections are omitted.

assets.description: Links attached to the release. GitLab attaches them as release links; GitHub and Forgejo have no such endpoint, so they are appended to the release body as an Assets list.

sign.description: auto signs when a key is present; required fails before anything is pushed; off never signs.

author.description: Identity for the release commit. Defaults to KOH Release Bot <release-bot@ole-hartwig.eu>; a release commit is made by automation, not by whoever merged.

gitlab_release.description: The release object on the forge. Named for GitLab, where it started; the same block publishes to GitHub and Forgejo, which yasrt detects from the job environment.

assets.description: Links attached to the release. GitLab attaches them as release links; GitHub and Forgejo have no such endpoint, so they are appended to the release body as an Assets list.

triggers.description: Follow-up pipelines via the GitLab trigger API. Failures are logged and never fail the release. On GitHub and Forgejo every trigger is reported as undeliverable.

variables.description: Variables passed to the target pipeline. ${version}, ${tag} and $ENV references are substituted. The estate's renovate contract is RELEASED_PACKAGE and RELEASED_VERSION (the tag).

hooks.description: External programs run at defined points. yasrt's extension mechanism; deliberately out of process.

run.description: Executable. Resolved relative to the repository when it starts with ./ or ../, through PATH otherwise.

args.description: Passed verbatim; no shell is involved.

name.description: Label used in logs and in the release report.

timeout.description: Go duration such as 90s or 5m. Default 5m.

allow_failure.description: Overrides the per-event default: fatal for before_tag and after_tag, tolerated for after_analysis and after_release.
